claims.evidence: The witness did not see the front of the device or a measurement to confirm the screen size.
The brand logo or manufacturer's label was not visible or readable in the dark photo of the rear.
Internal component failure cannot be diagnosed through external photos of the casing.

risks.risk: The CRT screen may be cracked, scratched, or have 'burn-in'.
risks.proof: A clear, well-lit photo of the front screen while the device is turned off.
risks.if_unproven: As a unit with a damaged tube (scrap value only).

risks.risk: The device may be a smaller or different model than claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's sticker on the back showing the model number.

risks.risk: Internal copper or components may have been scavenged.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear showing all casing screws are present and the ports are intact.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the front of the television.
Clear, well-lit photo of the manufacturer's label/sticker on the back.
Photo of the input ports (AV/RF) to check for physical damage.
response.reason: The witness report is based on a single, poorly lit photo of the rear; the brand, size, and screen integrity are unverified, and the seller admits the device is non-functional.
